card.name: Mid-sentence words before a main point
card.fires_on: Short linking or hedging words (a comma, 'that', 'the', 'may', 'Hopefully', 'guarantee') that sit just before the key statement of a sentence in general web prose, often after 'And that' or an interjected phrase.

modes.label: Comma after 'And that'
modes.description: A comma right after an opening 'And that' where the speaker is about to state the main point.
modes.example: And that<<,>> I believe, is the starting point for

modes.label: Hedge or stance word
modes.description: An adverb or verb of stance that introduces a claim or hope about what follows.
modes.example: <<Hopefully>> the students at the Ed Endres Boys

modes.label: Word after an appositive
modes.description: A small word that follows a name or aside and leads into a descriptive phrase.
modes.example: think of Chris,<< the>> person who helped make it possible

card.plain: It fires on small words that set up the main point of a sentence, such as a comma after 'And that' or 'Hopefully'.
